result.changelog: All 7 entries corrected and kept between 325 and 399 words. Gunship: rewritten around the corrected ship order (red ship; Prime-era ship, the first Hunter-class; classic ship used on Aether and later SR388, Zebes and the Bottle Ship; Phazon-crisis ship; violet ship). The registration line now reads 'under her name'. The Command Visor now stays offline until Rundas's rescue. Energy restoration is no longer universal (Bottle Ship exception). The logbook quote became a paraphrase. Ship Grapple now gathers the Theronian Bomb parts. Removed: autopilot, Federation-issued ship-command devices, 'Spire Dock', 'instead', the save-hatch line, and the generic keys her ship, starship and spaceship. Stations: deleted the 'precaution' speculation and the meta 'first location' line. The gunship exception was added and the Map Station claim softened. Total Recharge Station was confirmed via search snippets. Keys expanded, but the 12-key cap applies. Navigation: Dread fixed (Raven Beak masqueraded as ADAM at Network Stations after Samus fell to him, exposed on Itorash; the real ADAM speaks from the gunship). The Navigation Booth mislabel and the wiki guess about the rooms' purpose were removed. The Fusion reveal now happens during the argument over destroying the station. Data Room destruction now uses the computer's in-game warning. Generic keys removed. Elevators: BSL outage corrected (auxiliary power insufficient; the outage ended only after the roots' source was destroyed). Uncited claims removed: portals vanishing, hologram scanning, 'centuries'. Portal generators are now listed by location, and the Tanamaar find is called 'an ancient artifact'. Everyday keys replaced with specific ones. Bounty: definition fixed to the manual's 'large rewards when they captured pirates'. Contracts now in story order, with ZDR added. Self-initiated missions now include Orpheon, Ceres/Zebes and the Bottle Ship. 'Vaccines' replaced by the Aurora Unit virus purge. Weavel and Spire wording fixed. Sylux's Prime 4 backstory added. Removed: Old Bird 'protector' line, Adam's 'expensive' remark, the device line, and single-word keys. Species index: Lamorn/griever cause corrected, Earth HQ removed (human origin now via the manga's K-2L), Sylux updated, Reptilicus hedged, the unverified 'Chosen One' line dropped, generic keys replaced with plurals and aliases. Planets index: K-2L marked 'per the manga' and no longer called destroyed. Cylosis 'arid', the Earth-HQ line and ZDR as Raven Beak's homeworld removed. Bes III is now 'little-known'. The planet/planets/star system keys were replaced with named places.
result.unresolved: Total Recharge Station and Network Station rest only on WebSearch snippets: a Wikitroid snippet (that site is blocked) and a walkthrough. Neither is on Metroid Wiki. Raven Beak's motive ('to push her toward awakening her Metroid DNA') and the timing of the impersonation come from Looper and the fact-check. Wikipedia confirms only that he was 'masquerading as Adam' and was confronted on Itorash. Sylux's rank differs between sources: Wikipedia says field captain, Metroid Wiki says trooper. The entry uses field captain. 'Samus named the computer Adam', the Missile Battery/Big Energy Ball aboard the SR388 gunship, the Mega Core-X absorbing the Varia data, and Trace/Kriken details were carried over from the draft without a fresh check. None was flagged. The Desolan System is confirmed only through fan-wiki results. The 12-key cap dropped some plurals (Missile Stations, Ammo Stations) and left Kalandor, Dasha Region, Tanamaar, Viewros, Alinos, Arcterra and the Bermuda planets unkeyed in the planets index. Those keys are assumed to belong to other domains' entries.
